title: Scoring library: precision/recall/F1, breakpoint distance, partner-resolution, CIs
context: M1 scoring library for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Implements the versioned match rule (matchrule-v1) and computes precision/recall/F1, breakpoint distance, partner-resolution, and bootstrap confidence intervals. The integrity rule of the project - no point estimate without a CI and n - is enforced here by tests. Operates only on simulated/open data; emits no patient-facing claim.
objective: Ship a tested scoring library implementing matchrule-v1 that reports F1, breakpoint distance, separate partner-resolution, n-per-stratum, and bootstrap CIs, refusing to emit any point estimate without CI + n.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements the versioned match rule; partner-resolution scored separately from F1.
Reports n-per-stratum and bootstrap confidence intervals; unit tests cover edge cases (no-call, multi-call, off-by-tolerance breakpoints).
No point estimate emitted without CI + n (enforced by tests).
output: A pull request adding the scoring library (src/scoring/) implementing matchrule-v1 with CI-bounded metrics and tests.
